overview_description.description: Mozper is a pay-card and app designed for kids and parents in Latin America (Greenlight for LatAm). We let parents give their kids an allowance, set spending rules, assign chores and track savings goals, enabling them to give children a hands-on financial education appropriate for the digital era. By capturing consumers at a young age and offering demand-driven products and services as they grow, we aim to become their primary bank into adulthood and be the bank of the family for Latin America.
